name: Spark Tools
description: Check and simulate inference configurations, compiler resources, schedulers, and MoE layouts for DGX Spark.
compatibility: Python 3.10+ CPU tools; optional CUDA device validation; explicit TensorFold and OpenAI endpoint adapters.
limitations: Most checks need no GPU; optional device validation needs a compatible GPU and toolchain.
Simulations and static checks do not establish real throughput, GPU correctness, or model quality; timing predictions need calibration.

sources.note: Documents the listed workflow, requirements, compatibility, and limitations.
